name: Blue Lady

facts.text: Level 65, 30,000 health. Every 25-45 seconds she summons swords and axes; her Mana Bomb deals 800 cold over 550 every 25-35 seconds.
Players in 2002 said she summons about five swords and resummons them; in 2003 that after a wipe the swords roam the whole dungeon.
She cannot be hurt outside her tether.

story: The Blue Lady keened for the weapons. In the old hills a warrior's sword was half his name, and when it broke in a lord's service someone sang for it. She sang for every blade broken in Caimheul's wars, and when her song changed they came back whole, without the hands that held them. Swords and axes rise around her and fight on their own. She is the most dangerous of the three in a careless raid, for her blades do not go home when their enemy dies. They wander the caves looking for the next hand to cut, and the miners' children of Breifine are told that the clinking in the hills at night is the Blue Lady's swords, walking.
legend: Her swords and axes keep coming every half minute or so: mezz or root them, or kill them, then her. Spread against the cold bomb, it hits hard and wide. And do not wipe on her: in the old days the swords roamed the whole dungeon afterwards and killed anything living.

aggro: Rise, blades. Your masters are gone, but the fight is not.

phases.text: Steel rises from the floor without a hand.

slay: Your sword will keep fighting for me.

lairEntry: Blades lie on the floor. They are not still.

phases.text: Swords and axes rise around the Blue Lady!

atmosphere.realmFirstKill: The Blue Lady's blades lie down at last.
